replacement:
define "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening Positive and Follow Up Provided":
  from
    "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening" LastAdolescentScreen,
    "Follow Up Intervention for Positive Adolescent Depression Screening" FollowUpPositiveAdolescentScreen,
    "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period" QualifyingEncounter
    let FollowUpDateTime: Coalesce(start of FollowUpPositiveAdolescentScreen.performed.toInterval(), FollowUpPositiveAdolescentScreen.authoredOn, FollowUpPositiveAdolescentScreen.recorded)
    where LastAdolescentScreen.effective.toInterval ( ) starts 14 days or less on or before day of start of QualifyingEncounter.period
      and LastAdolescentScreen.value ~ "Depression screening positive (finding)"
      and FollowUpDateTime in day of Interval[end of LastAdolescentScreen.effective.toInterval(), end of QualifyingEncounter.period + 2 days]
      and FollowUpDateTime during day of "Measurement Period"

define "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening Positive and Depression Management Active":
  from
    "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening" LastAdolescentScreen,
    "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period" QualifyingEncounter,
    [Procedure: "Active Depression Management"] ActiveAdolescentManagement
    let ManagementDateTime: Coalesce(start of ActiveAdolescentManagement.performed.toInterval(), ActiveAdolescentManagement.recorded)
    where ActiveAdolescentManagement.status = 'completed'
      and LastAdolescentScreen.effective.toInterval ( ) starts 14 days or less on or before day of start of QualifyingEncounter.period
      and LastAdolescentScreen.value ~ "Depression screening positive (finding)"
      and ManagementDateTime on or after end of LastAdolescentScreen.effective.toInterval()
      and ManagementDateTime on or before day of end of QualifyingEncounter.period + 2 days
      and ManagementDateTime during day of "Measurement Period"

define "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening Positive and Depression Medication Active":
  from
    [MedicationRequest: "Adolescent Depression Medications"] ActiveAdolescentMedication,
    "Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening" LastAdolescentScreen,
    "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period" QualifyingEncounter
    where LastAdolescentScreen.effective.toInterval ( ) starts 14 days or less on or before day of start of QualifyingEncounter.period
      and LastAdolescentScreen.value ~ "Depression screening positive (finding)"
      and ActiveAdolescentMedication.status = 'active'
      and ActiveAdolescentMedication.intent in { 'order', 'original-order', 'reflex-order', 'filler-order', 'instance-order' }
      and ActiveAdolescentMedication.medicationRequestPeriod ( ).toInterval ( ) overlaps after day of QualifyingEncounter.period
